subtopic: Guaranteed Minimum Income and Accumulation Benefits
source_evidence: Guaranteed minimum income benefits. These benefits provide a minimum value you can turn into a stream of income payments, regardless of market performance. Guaranteed minimum accumulation benefits. These benefits provide that your contract value will be at least equal to a stated minimum amount after a specified number of years, regardless of market performance.
question: How does a guaranteed minimum income benefit differ from a guaranteed minimum accumulation benefit in a variable annuity?
answer: A guaranteed minimum income benefit provides a minimum value that you can convert into a stream of income payments, regardless of market performance. A guaranteed minimum accumulation benefit instead guarantees that the contract value will be at least a stated minimum after a specified number of years, regardless of market performance.
